degree_required.value: High school diploma or equivalent; completion of approved nursing education program
degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of an accredited high school or the equivalent... Complete a course of study approved by the board pursuant to section 152.5.

accrediting_body.quote: All programs preparing a person to be a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse shall be approved by the board.

exams.name: National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX)
exams.quote: Pass an examination as prescribed by the board.

available.quote: A license possessed by an applicant from a state which has not adopted the nurse licensure compact contained in section 152E.1 or the advanced practice registered nurse compact contained in section 152E.3 shall be recognized by the board under conditions specified which indicate that the licensee meets all the qualifications required under section 152.7.

requirements.value: Recognition based on whether foreign licensee is qualified to practice nursing; board may issue license by endorsement without examination
requirements.quote: If a foreign license is recognized, the board may issue a license by endorsement without an examination being required.

exists.quote: For nursing, three registered nurses, one of whom shall be actively engaged in practice, one of whom shall be a nurse educator from a nursing education program, and one of whom shall be an advanced registered nurse practitioner; one licensed practical nurse actively engaged in practice; and one member who is not a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse and who shall represent the general public.

credential_type.quote: The board may license a natural person to practice as a registered nurse, as a licensed practical nurse, or as an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not engage in the practice of... nursing... unless the person has obtained a license for that purpose from the board for the profession.

title_protection.quote: only a person currently licensed as a registered nurse in this state may use that title and the letters "R.N." after the person's name; only a person currently licensed as a licensed practical nurse in this state may use that title and the letters "L.P.N." after the person's name; and only a person currently licensed as an advanced registered nurse practitioner may use that title and the letters "A.R.N.P." after the person's name.

scope_protection.quote: The "practice of nursing" means the practice of a registered nurse, a licensed practical nurse, or an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continued practice while knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease which could be harmful to a patient's welfare.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse revoked or suspended, or having other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring, advising, or allowing a person to unlawfully practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of willful or repeated departure from or the failure to conform to the minimum standard of acceptable and prevailing practice of nursing; however, actual injury to a patient need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material or as a result of a mental or physical condition.

definition_quote.quote: The "practice of nursing" means the practice of a registered nurse, a licensed practical nurse, or an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

value: Formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment
Case finding, referral, health teaching, health counseling
Care provision which is supportive to or restorative of life and well-being
Execute regimen prescribed by a physician, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant
Supervise and teach other personnel in the performance of activities relating to nursing care
Assist in administration of immunizations and vaccinations
methods_authorized.quote:
Formulate nursing diagnosis and conduct nursing treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems through services, such as case finding, referral, health teaching, health counseling, and care provision which is supportive to or restorative of life and well-being.
 b. Execute regimen prescribed by a physician, an advanced registered nurse practitioner, or a physician assistant.
 c. Supervise and teach other personnel in the performance of activities relating to nursing care.
 d. Perform additional acts or nursing specialties which require education and training under emergency or other conditions which are recognized by the medical and nursing professions and are approved by the board as being proper to be performed by a registered nurse.
 e. Make the pronouncement of death for a patient whose death is anticipated if the death occurs in a licensed hospital, a licensed health care facility, a correctional institution listed in section 904.102, a Medicare-certified home health agency, a Medicare-certified hospice program or facility, an assisted living facility, or a residential care facility, with notice of the death to a physician, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.
 f. Under a pharmacist's order and consistent with this subsection, assist in the administration of immunizations and vaccinations

drug_authority.value: Under a pharmacist's order and consistent with this subsection, assist in the administration of immunizations and vaccinations and the utilization of statewide protocols
drug_authority.quote: Under a pharmacist's order and consistent with this subsection, assist in the administration of immunizations and vaccinations and the utilization of statewide protocols pursuant to section 155A.33B.

license_tiers.quote: The board may license a natural person to practice as a registered nurse, as a licensed practical nurse, or as an advanced registered nurse practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a nurse anesthetist, nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, or clinical nurse specialist to the extent a party state licenses or grants authority to practice in that advanced practice registered nurse role and title.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Perform services in the provision of supportive or restorative care under the supervision of a registered nurse or a physician.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Supervise and teach other personnel in the performance of activities relating to nursing care.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical or vocational nurse, under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: Establish a licensee review committee for the purpose of evaluating and monitoring licensees who are impaired as a result of substance use disorder, dependency, or addiction, or by any mental or physical disorder or disability, and who self-report the impairment to the committee, or who are referred by the board to the committee.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: Make the pronouncement of death for a patient whose death is anticipated if the death occurs in a licensed hospital, a licensed health care facility, a correctional institution listed in section 904.102, a Medicare-certified home health agency, a Medicare-certified hospice program or facility, an assisted living facility, or a residential care facility, with notice of the death to a physician, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.
